note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Nepal: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. Read again 2026-11-03 at the source, the Act as the Nepal Law Commission consolidates it (its own PDF, read from the page images since the text layer garbles Devanagari): the child is anyone under eighteen (s. 2(क), amended by the Act of 2074), so the approval, the hours and the night bar reach fourteen- to seventeen-year-olds, not fourteen to sixteen as the FAOLEX English of the original text had it; the FAOLEX copy is no longer cited.

figures.finding: Nepal has no child-performer permit: no child under fourteen may be engaged in work as a labourer; a child of fourteen to eighteen may work only with the approval of the labour office and of a parent or guardian, never from 18:00 to 06:00, at most six hours a day and 36 a week, with half an hour's break after three hours and a day off each week. A 'child' has been anyone under eighteen since the Act amending, consolidating, adjusting and repealing some Nepal laws, 2074; the file held the band as fourteen to sixteen until 2026-11-03, from FAOLEX's English text of the Act as passed in 2000. The Act binds an 'enterprise' (प्रतिष्ठान, now as the Labour Act 2074 s. 2(ञ) defines it) and has no performing exception, save that no approval is needed for cultural programmes an approved academic institution or a child-rights organisation organises (reading: it reaches a film production company employing a child actor, writer or director alike).

value.reachesWritingDirecting: yes, any work in an enterprise (reading)

figures.applies: Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act 2056 (2000) ss. 2, 3, 6, 9, as the Nepal Law Commission consolidates it with the amending Acts of 2074 and 2075.

sources.said: (क) “बालक” भन्नाले अठार वर्ष उमेर पूरा नगरेको बालबालिका सम्झनु पर्छ ।
३. (१) कसैले पनि चौध वर्ष उमेर पूरा नगरेका बालकलाई श्रमिकको रुपमा काममा लगाउनु हुँदैन ।
र बालकको बाबु, आमा वा संरक्षकको स्वीकृति लिनु पर्नेछ ।
सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रममा लगाउन यस दफा बमोजिम स्वीकृति लिनु पर्ने छैन ।
९. (१) बालकलाई बेलुका छ बजेपछि बिहान छ बजेसम्मको अवधिभर काममा लगाउनु हुँदैन ।
(२) बालकलाई काममा लगाउँदा दिनमा छ घण्टा र एक सप्ताहमा छत्तीस घण्टाभन्दा बढी अतिरिक्त पारिश्रमिक दिई वा नदिई काममा लगाउनु हुँदैन ।
(३) बालकलाई प्रत्येक दिन लगातार तीन घण्टा काम गरेपछि आधा घण्टा आराम गर्ने समय र प्रत्येक सप्ताहमा एक दिनको बिदा दिनु पर्नेछ ।

sources.title: बाल श्रम (निषेध र नियमित गर्ने) ऐन, २०५६, consolidated with its amendments of 2074 and 2075 (Nepal Law Commission, linked from https://lawcommission.gov.np/content/13306/child-labor--prohibition-and-regular--act--2056/), ss. 2(क), 3(1), 6(1), 9(1)-(3); its text layer garbles Devanagari, read from the page images

(१) कसैले पनि चौध वर्ष उमेर पूरा नगरेका बालकलाई श्रमिकको रुपमा काममा लगाउनु हुँदैन । ... ६. (१) कुनै प्रतिष्ठानले बालकलाई काममा लगाउनु परेमा सम्बन्धित श्रम कार्यालय वा सो कार्यालयले तोकेको अन्य कुनै निकाय वा अधिकारी र बालकको बाबु, आमा वा संरक्षकको स्वीकृति लिनु पर्नेछ । तर नेपाल सरकारबाट स्वीकृति प्राप्त शिक्षण संस्था वा बालकको हक र हितको संरक्षणको निमित्त कार्यरत प्रचलित कानून बमोजिम स्थापित संस्थाद्वारा बालकको बृहत हितको निमित्त आयोजना गरिने काममा वा सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रममा लगाउन यस दफा बमोजिम स्वीकृति लिनु पर्ने छैन । ... ९.
